title: Output size of the stock 4K movie request: 3840 x 2160 -> 4224 x 2816 (size class 3, second entry)
status: the word and guards of outsz2560_fx3_v1 (which runs on FX3s) with another size; never run on a camera

sites.what: size class 3, second entry: width, height

guards.what: size class 3, first entry and the raw write buffer id

precondition: a movie mode has run its size set-up (the table is zero before); the camera is on stills when the word is written
restore: the old word, or a cold boot
not_shown: the output records' format code on this camera (taken as 2, 1.25 bytes per pixel: 3840 x 2560 records in the stock units)
goes_with: dmm7slot_fx3_v1 FIRST (a plane of 14,868,480 bytes at 1.25 bytes per pixel does not fit the stock 13,271,040-byte units of id 0x2d9), ogh2816_fx3_v1 (front end 4240 x 2816; the second scaler takes 4224 x 2816 at scale 1) and ogfile4224_fx3_v1
division_job: the FX3's own job 0x43a4f4 accepts 4240 x 2816 -> 4224 x 2816 with two units of 2112 (build/division_sizes_s3.py --build fx3_702); 4240 wide is refused
